# Pack — Brightloom Kirana

Brightloom Kirana is a quick-commerce company based in Bengaluru. 10-minute grocery delivery for tier-2 cities.

## Metrics (latest quarter)
- ARR: ₹8.8 crore
- Growth, year on year: 112%
- Net burn: ₹45 lakh per month
- Runway: 23 months
- Headcount: 131
- Net revenue retention: 100%
- Gross margin: 68%
- Paying customers: 283

## Deal
- Raising: $3 million
- Ownership on offer: 12%

## Transcript excerpt — board call
ANAYA VERMILLION: Retention is the thing we are proudest of this quarter. The expansion motion inside existing accounts is finally working, and that is what is carrying net revenue retention.
KABIR ASHGROVE: The counterweight is that new logo acquisition slowed. We are relying more on expansion than we would like, and the top of the funnel needs work before the next raise.

## Transcript excerpt — founder catch-up
ANAYA VERMILLION: Hiring is the bottleneck. We have the budget signed off but the senior engineering market is brutal and we have lost two candidates at offer stage.
ANAYA VERMILLION: On the product side, the reporting module is what customers ask for in every single advisory call. It is now the next thing we build.

## Recent news
1. Brightloom Kirana signed a reseller agreement with a systems integrator covering the healthcare segment.
2. Vikram Ollandry, who led revenue at Brightloom Kirana, has left the company.
3. Brightloom Kirana moved from seat-based to usage-based pricing across its self-serve tier.

## Previously reported to the investment committee
- Brightloom Kirana signed a reseller agreement with a systems integrator covering the healthcare segment.
- Brightloom Kirana closed its seed round led by Greyloft Ventures.
- Brightloom Kirana appointed Kabir Ashgrove as Head of Data.
